subproblems.title: Rigorous four-dimensional Yang-Mills construction and positive mass gap
subproblems.open_question: Can interacting four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory be constructed rigorously and shown to possess a strictly positive mass gap?
decisive_resolution: a complete axiomatic construction with continuum limit and positive gap
a rigorous obstruction that decisively invalidates a major construction route
excluded_outputs: a finite-lattice numerical gap alone
one improved bound without a controlled continuum theorem

subproblems.title: Universal nonperturbative mechanism of color confinement
subproblems.open_question: Which gauge-invariant mechanism produces color confinement and nonzero continuum string tension in non-Abelian gauge theory?
decisive_resolution: a continuum-controlled confinement criterion with universal spectral consequences
a decisive exclusion of a major proposed confinement mechanism across its stated domain
excluded_outputs: one small Wilson-loop bound
a gauge-dependent diagnostic without universality tests

subproblems.title: QCD origin of proton mass and spin
subproblems.open_question: How do quark and gluon energy, orbital motion and quantum anomalies quantitatively generate the proton mass and spin?
decisive_resolution: a scheme-explicit closed mass or spin decomposition consistent across first-principles theory and experiment
resolution of a recognized missing gluon or orbital component with controlled evolution
excluded_outputs: one PDF fit with unchanged uncertainty
a decomposition whose scheme dependence is hidden

subproblems.title: Existence and location of a QCD critical point
subproblems.open_question: Does QCD contain a critical endpoint or first-order transition at finite baryon density, and where is it located?
decisive_resolution: controlled establishment of critical behavior in a predeclared physical region
controlled exclusion of a materially complete region targeted by current programs
excluded_outputs: a single fluctuation anomaly
analytic continuation without a systematic-error closure

subproblems.title: Phases and degrees of freedom of cold dense QCD matter

a robust phase or equation-of-state exclusion over a predeclared density range
excluded_outputs: one flexible equation-of-state fit
a model preference dominated by an untested prior

subproblems.title: Controlled access to finite-density QCD despite the sign problem

excluded_outputs: a toy-model speedup
